query: How has Marcus's engagement with traffic and safety issues on Maple Street changed over the sessions?
gold: Marcus mentioned traffic concerns incidentally in Session 1 (worried about scaffolding blocking the school gate during works) but did not escalate. By Session 3, after a car reversed toward his son at the school gate without seeing him, Marcus shifted immediately to formal escalation: 'As a parent this has to be dealt with. I'm raising this formally today.' From that point his engagement intensified — he frames almost every subsequent safety or development discussion through the lens of child safety at the school gate, and he follows up unresolved threads rather than letting them drop.
context:
[1] (about=Marcus, episodic, t3 @2025-05-19T08:47:00) Really concerning one from the school gate this morning. A car reversed off no. 19's driveway and my son was right there, driver didn't see him. He's fine but I'm shaking. I'm raising this formally today.
[2] (about=Marcus, episodic, t2 @2025-05-12T15:35:00) I'm in favour. As a parent, the school gate situation is untenable, people park on the pavement all morning. Permits would fix that overnight.
[3] (about=Femi, episodic, t4 @2025-05-19T08:53:00) Marcus, so glad your son is okay. Absolutely raise it. Do you want to coordinate with the rest of us first? A joint request for a traffic assessment would carry more weight.
[4] (about=Marcus, episodic, t4 @2025-05-19T19:30:00) thanks all. I'm sorry, I'm still properly shaken
[5] (about=Jordan, episodic, t4 @2025-05-19T09:08:00) oh that's so scary, glad he's ok 💛 lmk if there's something I can sign
[6] (about=Femi, episodic, t2 @2025-05-12T15:49:00) I'm broadly in favour. My concern is the commuter overflow onto the next street.
[7] (about=Femi, episodic, t2 @2025-05-12T18:15:00) Good to have views from everyone. So: Vera and Marcus in favour, Claudette against, Jordan neutral, me broadly yes with caveats. I'll represent that range at the consultation meeting. Thanks all.
[8] (about=Claudette, episodic, t4 @2025-05-19T09:02:00) How frightening. I remember when this was a quiet road. All this traffic is exactly what happens when you allow more development, more occupants, more cars, more danger for our children.
[9] (about=Claudette, episodic, t4 @2025-05-19T19:34:00) include the driveway at no. 19 in the note. That corner has been bad for months
[10] (about=Vera, episodic, t4 @2025-05-19T19:14:00) Already contacted highways directly about the school gate. Didn't post here first. Needed immediate action.
[11] (about=Marcus, core, t3 @2025-05-19T08:47:00) will formally raise the near-miss incident at the school gate with a car reversing off no. 19's driveway, where his son was nearly hit
[12] (about=Marcus, said_by=Femi, profile, t4 @2025-05-19T08:53:00) Marcus is shaken by the near-miss incident and appreciates the group's support
agent_answer: Marcus's engagement changed from broadly supporting traffic measures (parking permits) in the discussion session to personally and formally raising a specific near-miss incident after his son was almost hit, and he became emotionally shaken while appreciating the group's support.
